title: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing - Cultural and Creative Arts - Exhibition and Display Techniques
exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: The organized public display of art and craft works for appreciation, evaluation, or purchase is known as:
questions.explain: An exhibition is a curated, organized presentation of artworks (like paintings, crafts, sculptures) so that the public or critics can view and appreciate them.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which location is a specialized institution dedicated to preserving, protecting, and exhibiting historical and cultural artifacts permanently?
questions.explain: Museums are institutions primarily focused on the permanent conservation, research, and display of historically and culturally significant items for public education.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Unlike a museum, what is the primary purpose of a commercial Art Gallery?
options: To temporarily exhibit artworks predominantly for the purpose of selling them to collectors.
To hide artworks from the general public.
To store old, broken archaeological pottery.
questions.explain: Art galleries operate on a commercial basis. While they exhibit art to the public, their ultimate goal is usually to sell the displayed pieces to buyers, generating profit for the artist and the gallery.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: To ensure maximum visibility and viewer comfort during an exhibition, flat 2D artworks like framed paintings should generally be hung:
options: At the average human eye level.
questions.explain: Standard display technique dictates that paintings should be hung so the center of the artwork sits comfortably at average eye level, minimizing the need for viewers to strain their necks.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: When exhibiting three-dimensional objects like vases or wood carvings, which display equipment is most appropriate to use?
questions.explain: 3D objects are best displayed on elevated, sturdy stands known as pedestals (or plinths), allowing viewers to walk around and appreciate the object from all angles.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which of the following venues offers a broad, open marketplace where producers, artists, and business owners temporarily gather to promote and sell a variety of products to massive crowds?
questions.explain: Trade fairs are massive, often temporary, commercial exhibitions where artists and vendors set up booths to showcase and market their goods to a huge demographic.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: If an artist places a beautifully woven basket in a glass case at an exhibition, what display technique is the artist using and why?
options: A hidden display, to make sure no one sees it.
An enclosure display, to protect a delicate piece while still allowing 360-degree viewing.
A mural display, to paste it to a wall.
A mobile display, to make the basket fly.
questions.explain: Glass cases (vitrines) are a standard display technique for delicate or highly valuable 3D objects, protecting them from dust and touching while remaining fully visible.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts
